diagnostic_plan: Isolated source/target; counting allocator and heaptrack, no new runtime algorithm. Stage exits intentionally retain reachable values for end-live attribution and are not leak/completion evidence. Full run and full-drop replay remain separate. Capture raw traces and source attribution.
acceptance: Before retention change, independent exact arithmetic/continued-success controls; cold/warm/source-drop/concurrent/low-high-low/strict-approximate-strict and cancelled retry where applicable. Requested allocation traffic, live/peak and requery/native tail latency separately. No lower-priority memory gain overrides completion or latency. Entry-count caps are not coefficient-byte bounds.
excluded: No S01 workspace/cache coordination, global strong interning, Hypercurve purge, resubmission of old per-call memo variants, or proof-authority eviction.
stop_rule: If transient work sets peaks and retained forms are cheaper than repeated exact work, do not adopt a retention policy without a measured contrary workload.
